newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Intl Paper raised to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Intl Paper raised to buy.

text.p: UBS Securities said Wednesday it upgraded International Paper Co to buy from hold.
-- Raised 1997 earnings estimate to $1.20 per share from $1.05.
-- In a research note, analyst Mark Diverio cited International Paper's announcement Tuesday of restructuring actions as the primary motivation for the upgrade.
-- Said the restructuring program "finally appears to underscore a sense of urgency that investors have been looking for from management."
-- Also said "historical stock valuation parameters suggest potential upside to $70."
